content.text: Back home. Locked in. 💙 Match 4 for the Lucknow Super Giants vs Gujarat Titans at Ekana Stadium. The squad is back in Lucknow, back to their base, and fully focused for the next challenge. From intense practice sessions to light moments between players and staff, it’s all about getting ready the right way for a big afternoon clash. Final prep done. Time to deliver. 🕞 3:30 PM | Ekana Stadium Game on. 🔥 ---------- ABOUT LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS (LSG) Lucknow Super Giants (LSG) is a professional cricket franchise that competes in the Indian Premier League (IPL). The team represents Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, and plays its home matches at the Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium.
